45M Class A shares at $3.00 per share, generating ~$135M in gross proceeds.
Investors will also receive warrants to purchase up to 90M additional Class A shares.
50% of the warrants will be exercisable at $6.00 per share, while the remaining 50% will be exercisable at $7.50 per share.
Following the share issuance, AIFU expects to have 61.18M ordinary shares outstanding, assuming no warrant exercise.
The largest investor is expected to own ~56.12% of outstanding shares, but only 3.19% of aggregate voting power, reflecting AIFU’s share-class structure.

title: AIFU announces $135M share financing
